Hero portraits on the battle side panel now include vertical HP bars that update in real time, display shields and delayed HP loss, and turn gray when a hero is defeated. events.summary: Fixes Fixed an issue where the currency amount displayed on the refresh button in the Forge screen was incorrect. Fixed an issue where stat bonuses from certain Relics were not correctly displayed in the character panel after progressing to the next stage.
